title: Roamhaven Rewards Benefit Card — Tier Uplift on Travel-Issue Refunds
content:
# Roamhaven Rewards benefit card — tier uplift on a travel-issue nightly refund

**Benefit.** On an approved travel issue on a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category, Roamhaven Rewards members get a tier uplift on the share of each affected night refunded: a guest whose active Roamhaven Rewards tier includes a dedicated concierge adds 10 percentage points; a guest whose active Roamhaven Rewards tier includes the priority support line but no dedicated concierge adds 5 percentage points; any other guest adds nothing. With any uplift added, the share never exceeds 100 percent.

The guest's Roamhaven Rewards membership on record decides: its tier, the features that tier carries and whether it is active.

| Membership | Uplift on the share |
|---|---|
| active; tier includes a dedicated concierge | 10 percentage points |
| active; tier includes the priority support line, no dedicated concierge | 5 percentage points |
| any other guest | none |

## Applied to a 50 percent share (hypothetical)

Dedicated concierge: 60 percent. Priority support line only: 55 percent. No active membership: 50 percent. Applied to a 100 percent share, every line stays at 100 percent.
